name: entity-link
title: EntityLink
description: One entity that lives ELSEWHERE, shown with enough of itself to be recognised: inline inside a sentence, or as a card with its state and its meta. Wrap it in <HoverCard> when the preview should appear on hover instead of on the page. Copy: the title is the record's name; the meta says what is waiting inside it, which is the reason to follow the link at all.
docs: Part of the AI Design System. Its full contract — every prop, its allowed values and what each one means — is at https://github.com/axdes/AI-Design-system/blob/main/registry/EntityLink.json
